findings: The H3 cookbook selector lists AMD only as mi300x and mi355x; gfx1151 is not supportedHardware.
The requested B200 recipe is an 8-GPU NVIDIA/Ulysses topology and cannot be reproduced on one gfx1151 APU.
The cookbook labels GGUF transformer and GGUF text-encoder routes as CUDA capacity paths.
PR 39448 says current HIP execution is rejected before the denoise loop because the allowlist lacks current_platform.is_rocm(); the PR remains open.
Local ComfyUI already has native H3 nodes, validated H3 artifacts and gfx1151-compatible model variants, so it is the nearest verifiable route.

actions.reason: Compatibility gate failed before any long GPU job, as required by the card. Installing or downloading the full stack would not create a supported gfx1151 execution path.

nearest_verified_route: Existing local ComfyUI MiniMax-H3 ROCm workflow, serialized with all local LLM services stopped.
retest_trigger: SGLang merges ROCm H3 runtime support and publishes or CI-validates a consumer/gfx1151 route (or a generic ROCm torch_sdpa/eager recipe without MI-only kernels).
